newsitem.title: USA: S&P affirms Martin Marietta Materials debt.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Martin Marietta Materials debt.

text.p: Standard and Poor's on Monday affirmed Martin Marietta Material Inc's single-A corporate credit and senior unsecured debt ratings.

The ratings reflect the company's recently completed purchase of all of the common stock of American Aggregates Corp, a unit of CSR America Inc for about $230 million in cash plus the assumption of certain liabilities.
The increase in debt from conservative levels will likely be temporary, and the company's financial profile was strong for the ratings prior to this transaction, S&P said.

Additional acquisition opportunities are seen, given ongoing consolidation of the aggregates industry. Still, moderate internal capital spending requirements and management's operating expertise and deliberate acquisition strategy should sustain solid credit quality, S&P added.
